title: Further Daily Addition Where the Owner Holds a Response Commitment
content:
# Further Daily Addition Where the Owner Holds a Response Commitment

An owner of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects who also buys a response commitment from the company under its Demand Service Rate Programs is carrying a building that cannot be left without cooling, and a further addition is made to the daily amount of damages.

## Rule

Where the owner carries an active Demand Service Rate Program whose guaranteed response at a critical facility is 4 hours or less, a further critical facility addition of **USD 600 per day** is made to the daily amount.

Where the owner carries an active Demand Service Rate Program whose guaranteed response at a critical facility is more than 4 hours, a further standard addition of **USD 200 per day** is made to the daily amount.

Where the owner carries no active Demand Service Rate Program, no further addition is made to the daily amount, and **0 USD** is added.

## Both sides of the four-hour boundary

The response read is the response the owner's rate program guarantees at a critical facility, and the program must stand active. A guaranteed response of exactly 4 hours is 4 hours or less and takes the critical facility addition; a guaranteed response of 5 hours is more than 4 and takes the standard addition.

| Rate program standing | Guaranteed response at a critical facility | Further addition |
|---|---|---|
| active | 2 hours | USD 600 per day |
| active | 4 hours | USD 600 per day |
| active | 6 hours | USD 200 per day |
| active | 24 hours | USD 200 per day |
| not active, or none held | — | none |

## Worked addition (hypothetical)

An owner holding an active rate program with a guaranteed critical facility response of 4 hours adds USD 600 to each day of damages; an owner holding one guaranteed at 8 hours adds USD 200; an owner holding no rate program adds nothing.
